name: mcp-llm-database-context-integration
description: A general platform for integrating Large Language Models of your choice to a MCP Client and MCP server integration to a database of your choice
author: Miska Mynttinen

scripts.build: tsc && npm run mcp-client:build && npm run mcp-server:build
scripts.mcp-client:build: cd mcp-client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.mcp-server:build: cd mcp-server && npm install && npm run build
